execution_policy.worker_external_actions: None; no provider dispatch, remote execution, publishing, game capture/input, or game-file writes.
execution_policy.root_external_actions: Scoped Git commits/pushes and the requested draft release-candidate PR only for this planning pass.
execution_policy.verification_data: Synthetic fixtures and mocked desktop/Codex sender; no private runtime or game data.

deferred: Formal friend installation instructions and setup-script redesign
Fresh environment, source-ZIP installation, or other-device testing
Hosted CI and expanded Python/GPU/platform support matrix
Diagnostic ZIP bundles and automatic retention/deletion
Automatic mod changes, save/cloud synchronization, multiplayer input
License/copyright selection and a public beta release tag

items.objective: Make local startup and connection failures actionable in the existing development installation.
preconditions: Bind a single owner and checkout; no concurrent writes to the listed files.
Use the existing environment; do not run setup or install dependencies as part of this item.
deliverables: Non-capturing doctor output for interpreter, source/skill resources, and required Codex queue flags.
A visible local launch-failure path and specific descriptor/connection errors.
Focused mocked tests and concise current-machine usage notes.
preserve_contracts: Doctor never captures, sends input, queues a request, or prints credential values.
Preserve HTTP authentication error handling, expiry, STOP, and no retry after uncertain delivery.
Keep source installation assumptions explicit; no wheel support, data migration, or general path framework is required.
steps: Characterize missing-resource and connection-error cases with mocks.
Implement the diagnostics and local launch feedback within the allowed files.
Run the referenced checks and record observed outcomes.
acceptance: Missing CLI, missing queue/image capabilities, invalid connection JSON, connection refusal, and invalid responses have distinguishable remedies.
An HTTP authentication failure retains its authentication explanation.
Existing-source launch failure is visible instead of silently falling back to global Python.
Reported diagnostics exclude tokens and do not imply that a configured conversation has answered.
stop_when: The next action would require setup redesign, dependency installation, another host, a model request, or game operation.
Another writer owns a listed file; preserve work and return the ownership conflict.

items.objective: Make the existing panel usable and make conversation configuration distinct from callback confirmation.
preconditions: RC-01 is verified and its diagnostics are available.
Own the entire panel/dialog/session files during this item, not selected line ranges.
deliverables: Connect and Test connection controls with configured, queued, working, and callback-confirmed status.
Scrollable/responsive content and work-area-aware window/dialog placement with INPUT and STOP always reachable.
Skill instructions based on capture dimensions and the companion's supported focus/input path.
preserve_contracts: INPUT is off on startup; enabling it starts no work; cancelled/advice-only requests cannot gain authority.
A successful queue submission is not a callback, and busy status is not inferred without evidence.
Focus behavior remains bounded to the companion's existing rules; no optional external window tool is assumed.
steps: Specify layout and callback-state behavior using synthetic geometry and mocked completions.
Implement the controls/layout and revise the three existing skills.
Run local tests; record any native UI or live callback checks as unrun unless actually selected and observed.
acceptance: Pure geometry tests cover small work areas, scaling, negative origins, and monitor removal without another device.
INPUT/STOP remain reachable when content needs scrolling.
Mocked connection tests attach no image, grant no input, and confirm only the matching completion.
Stale/expired callbacks cannot mark a different request connected or trigger action.
stop_when: Completion would require a new capture backend, global hook installation, external desktop-control plugin, or another device.

items.objective: Keep usable history visible when some event records are damaged, without hiding damage or rewriting originals.
preconditions: Use only temporary synthetic history files.
Identify existing history response consumers before changing its result contract.
deliverables: Readable records plus a visible damaged-record count/warning.
Consistent CLI/HTTP/dialog handling for history recovery and tests for affected consumers.
preserve_contracts: Keep original event bytes and explicit save/session associations intact.
Do not silently reset corrupted active-session metadata or migrate/delete data.
Do not turn an unreadable source into a successful empty history.
steps: Add fixtures with a damaged line among valid records and malformed record shapes.
Implement recovery and warnings across the existing consumers.
Verify original fixture hashes, restart behavior, and the referenced checks.
acceptance: One damaged record does not hide all readable records in the requested history range.
The user can see that records were omitted and why; original bytes are unchanged.
Invalid top-level session state produces a specific error rather than a new empty session.
Existing valid-history behavior and limits remain covered.
stop_when: A proposed fix requires modifying real history, deleting records, automatic retention, or a data-root migration.

items.objective: Provide read-only mod configuration/file inventory, persisted snapshots, and changes since a previous scan.
preconditions: Use the selected game-data/profile location and synthetic fixtures, not a real mod scan during development.
Agree the snapshot result shape before adding CLI/HTTP consumers.
deliverables: Bounded XML/configuration and package-file inspection with source-specific outcomes.
Versioned snapshots tied to the selected play session/profile and a comparison of same-profile snapshots.
A local CLI/HTTP surface for the deterministic inventory and fixture tests.
preserve_contracts: Configured entries, file presence, and unknown/live-unverified state remain separate.
Preserve exact version strings and known order; do not infer identity from filenames.
Never write to game/save/mod folders, execute discovered files, capture a screen, or submit a model request.
A source read failure cannot fabricate removals or prove no mods are installed.
steps: Create fixtures for multiple profiles, missing/invalid XML, large versions, ambiguous files, and interrupted reads.
Implement bounded inspection, snapshot persistence, and same-profile differences.
Run mocked checks and prove source fixture bytes remain unchanged.
acceptance: Missing/unreadable/partial sources are explicit; no fabricated active-mod or multiplayer-compatible verdict.
Duplicate IDs, absent versions, configured order, file-only entries, and changing files have deterministic outcomes.
Snapshots and selected-profile associations survive restart.
Inventory needs no INPUT permission, running game, or Codex connection.
stop_when: The feature would need package extraction, an external mod manager, downloads, hash-heavy scans, game writes, or a live compatibility test.

items.objective: Make personal run notes and mod/setup context easy to review and share as a deliberate text report.
preconditions: Consume the established RC-04 inventory result; do not add another scanner.
Use synthetic report data and manual notes during verification.
deliverables: Manual campaign/host/party/objective notes associated with the existing play session.
Mods/run-summary view with asynchronous Refresh, previous-scan changes, preview, and explicit Copy.
An allowlisted formatter shared by the UI and CLI.
preserve_contracts: Copying the report sends no model request or message to friends.
Tokens/account IDs are never report fields; local paths/raw config are excluded.
Save labels and personal notes are excluded by default and included only through explicit preview selection.
Personal graphics preferences are not reported as multiplayer mismatches; a selected save is not claimed to be loaded.
steps: Define the default report allowlist and opt-in note/save fields with synthetic privacy cases.
Implement note persistence and the panel/dialog/CLI report consumers.
Run privacy, restart, asynchronous refresh, and existing mocked behavior checks.
acceptance: The copied text equals the preview, retains unknowns/provenance, and excludes private fields by default.
Refresh does not copy, send, or delay STOP.
Manual notes persist without automatic character/save-state extraction.
Two synthetic reports expose a known version/order difference for human comparison without claiming compatibility.
stop_when: Completion would require friend accounts, network sharing, import/synchronization, credential inclusion, or multiplayer game input.

items.objective: Make setup auditing honest about evidence and complete the local RC review against observed results.
preconditions: RC-01 through RC-05 are verified for their local mocked scope.
Recheck the complete branch diff and distinguish prior claims from newly observed evidence.
deliverables: Audit-first setup behavior with all three editable profiles and Balanced selected.
Unsupported/unknown GPU setting handling and clear separation of saved config, visible values, and unmeasured FPS.
Updated README/plan state and a concise local verification record for the RC.
preserve_contracts: Keep profile overrides and notes; do not migrate personal data.
Until live application is independently validated, setup requests remain advice-only even if general INPUT is enabled.
Normal Smart next move permission and gesture limits remain unchanged.
Do not call planned work implemented, mocked evidence live validation, or a local RC a tested friend release.
steps: Cover audit-only setup and unknown/unsupported settings in existing mocked tests.
Implement the narrow setup behavior and update user-visible status.
Root reviews the complete diff once, runs the full relevant mocked suite, and records remaining live/distribution work.
acceptance: All profiles and override notes persist, while an unverified setup flow cannot send settings gestures.
No unsupported GPU option or FPS improvement is asserted without evidence.
The complete mocked suite passes on the existing local environment at the recorded result commit.
Public evidence contains no private artifacts, and installation/other-device testing remains explicitly deferred.
stop_when: Completion would require a live game/settings action, another device, installation testing, release packaging, or a license decision.
An unresolved regression remains; keep the PR draft and report the failing acceptance criterion.
